summary: January is high summer in the south and the dry season across much of tropical Asia and the Americas.
intro: In the southern hemisphere January is the height of summer: long days in New Zealand and southern Australia, and beach weather in South Africa and South America. North of the equator it's the coldest month, which suits the ski resorts of the Alps and Japan, and the long Arctic nights when the northern lights are easiest to see.

It's also the heart of the dry season across much of South-East Asia, Mexico and the Caribbean, when their beaches are at their sunniest. In Europe the cities go quiet after New Year, and prices drop with the crowds.
